!53 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Three panes, one source. The struct is declared once, so both stages are handed\0A// the identical signature that -pack-optimized documents as its precondition.\0A//\0A// Pane 1 (dxc_1_6_2112, domain shader, -pack-optimized) and pane 2 (dxc_trunk,\0A// pixel shader, -pack-optimized): look at the SV_ClipDistance row of the domain\0A// shader's Output signature and of the pixel shader's Input signature. They give\0A// the same Mask and the same Register, and so do the PREVIOUSPOSITION, SV_Position\0A// and NORMAL rows -- the DS output layout and the PS input layout agree, on two\0A// compiler versions years apart.\0A//\0A// Pane 3 (dxc_trunk, pixel shader, no -pack-optimized): the SV_ClipDistance row\0A// now names a different Register and a different Mask, and the other three rows\0A// move with it. That layout, not pane 2's, is the pixel-shader table quoted in the\0A// issue -- which is what makes the domain shader and the pixel shader disagree.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// #3362 -- domain shader signature packing under -pack-optimized.\0A//\0A// Reconstruction of the configuration in the issue: the interstage struct is\0A// declared once and used by both the domain shader and the pixel shader that\0A// consumes it, exactly as the reporter describes (\22it's in a shared header, so\0A// it should be the same in all stages\22).  Both entry points live in one file so\0A// the two invocations in cmd.txt are guaranteed to see the identical\0A// declaration.\0A//\0A// The patch-constant input and the tri domain reproduce the attached\0A// disassembly's patch-constant signature (SV_TessFactor 0..2 + SV_InsideTessFactor)\0A// and InputControlPointCount=3.\0A\0Astruct PixelInput\0A{\0A\09float4 pos : SV_POSITION;\0A\09float  clip : SV_ClipDistance0;\0A\09float4 pre : PREVIOUSPOSITION;\0A\09float3 nor : NORMAL;\0A};\0A\0Astruct ConstantOutput\0A{\0A\09float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A\09float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A};\0A\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0APixelInput DSMain(ConstantOutput pc, float3 bary : SV_DomainLocation,\0A                  const OutputPatch<PixelInput, 3> patch)\0A{\0A\09PixelInput o;\0A\09o.pos = patch[0].pos * bary.x + patch[1].pos * bary.y + patch[2].pos * bary.z;\0A\09o.clip = patch[0].clip * bary.x + patch[1].clip * bary.y + patch[2].clip * bary.z;\0A\09o.pre = patch[0].pre * bary.x + patch[1].pre * bary.y + patch[2].pre * bary.z;\0A\09o.nor = patch[0].nor * bary.x + patch[1].nor * bary.y + patch[2].nor * bary.z;\0A\09return o;\0A}\0A\0Afloat4 PSMain(PixelInput input) : SV_Target\0A{\0A\09return input.pre + float4(input.nor, input.clip);\0A}\0A"}

!37 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// Three panes, one source. The struct is declared once, so both stages are handed\0A// the identical signature that -pack-optimized documents as its precondition.\0A//\0A// Pane 1 (dxc_1_6_2112, domain shader, -pack-optimized) and pane 2 (dxc_trunk,\0A// pixel shader, -pack-optimized): look at the SV_ClipDistance row of the domain\0A// shader's Output signature and of the pixel shader's Input signature. They give\0A// the same Mask and the same Register, and so do the PREVIOUSPOSITION, SV_Position\0A// and NORMAL rows -- the DS output layout and the PS input layout agree, on two\0A// compiler versions years apart.\0A//\0A// Pane 3 (dxc_trunk, pixel shader, no -pack-optimized): the SV_ClipDistance row\0A// now names a different Register and a different Mask, and the other three rows\0A// move with it. That layout, not pane 2's, is the pixel-shader table quoted in the\0A// issue -- which is what makes the domain shader and the pixel shader disagree.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// #3362 -- domain shader signature packing under -pack-optimized.\0A//\0A// Reconstruction of the configuration in the issue: the interstage struct is\0A// declared once and used by both the domain shader and the pixel shader that\0A// consumes it, exactly as the reporter describes (\22it's in a shared header, so\0A// it should be the same in all stages\22).  Both entry points live in one file so\0A// the two invocations in cmd.txt are guaranteed to see the identical\0A// declaration.\0A//\0A// The patch-constant input and the tri domain reproduce the attached\0A// disassembly's patch-constant signature (SV_TessFactor 0..2 + SV_InsideTessFactor)\0A// and InputControlPointCount=3.\0A\0Astruct PixelInput\0A{\0A\09float4 pos : SV_POSITION;\0A\09float  clip : SV_ClipDistance0;\0A\09float4 pre : PREVIOUSPOSITION;\0A\09float3 nor : NORMAL;\0A};\0A\0Astruct ConstantOutput\0A{\0A\09float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A\09float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A};\0A\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0APixelInput DSMain(ConstantOutput pc, float3 bary : SV_DomainLocation,\0A                  const OutputPatch<PixelInput, 3> patch)\0A{\0A\09PixelInput o;\0A\09o.pos = patch[0].pos * bary.x + patch[1].pos * bary.y + patch[2].pos * bary.z;\0A\09o.clip = patch[0].clip * bary.x + patch[1].clip * bary.y + patch[2].clip * bary.z;\0A\09o.pre = patch[0].pre * bary.x + patch[1].pre * bary.y + patch[2].pre * bary.z;\0A\09o.nor = patch[0].nor * bary.x + patch[1].nor * bary.y + patch[2].nor * bary.z;\0A\09return o;\0A}\0A\0Afloat4 PSMain(PixelInput input) : SV_Target\0A{\0A\09return input.pre + float4(input.nor, input.clip);\0A}\0A"}

Both entry points live in one file so\0A// the two invocations in cmd.txt are guaranteed to see the identical\0A// declaration.\0A//\0A// The patch-constant input and the tri domain reproduce the attached\0A// disassembly's patch-constant signature (SV_TessFactor 0..2 + SV_InsideTessFactor)\0A// and InputControlPointCount=3.\0A\0Astruct PixelInput\0A{\0A\09float4 pos : SV_POSITION;\0A\09float  clip : SV_ClipDistance0;\0A\09float4 pre : PREVIOUSPOSITION;\0A\09float3 nor : NORMAL;\0A};\0A\0Astruct ConstantOutput\0A{\0A\09float edges[3] : SV_TessFactor;\0A\09float inside : SV_InsideTessFactor;\0A};\0A\0A[domain(\22tri\22)]\0APixelInput DSMain(ConstantOutput pc, float3 bary : SV_DomainLocation,\0A                  const OutputPatch<PixelInput, 3> patch)\0A{\0A\09PixelInput o;\0A\09o.pos = patch[0].pos * bary.x + patch[1].pos * bary.y + patch[2].pos * bary.z;\0A\09o.clip = patch[0].clip * bary.x + patch[1].clip * bary.y + patch[2].clip * bary.z;\0A\09o.pre = patch[0].pre * bary.x + patch[1].pre * bary.y + patch[2].pre * bary.z;\0A\09o.nor = patch[0].nor * bary.x + patch[1].nor * bary.y + patch[2].nor * bary.z;\0A\09return o;\0A}\0A\0Afloat4 PSMain(PixelInput input) : SV_Target\0A{\0A\09return input.pre + float4(input.nor, input.clip);\0A}\0A"}
